QuestionStmt.S: If $\vec{A} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} + 3\hat{k}$, $\vec{B} = -\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 4\hat{k}$ and $\vec{C} = 2\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} - 8\hat{k}$, then the angle between the vectors $\vec{P} = \vec{A} + \vec{B} + \vec{C}$ and $\vec{Q} = (\vec{A} \times \vec{B})$ is (in degree)

Solution.S:
First compute $\vec{P}$:
$$\vec{P} = \vec{A} + \vec{B} + \vec{C} = (\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 3\hat{k}) + (-\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 4\hat{k}) + (2\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} - 8\hat{k})$$
$$= (1 - 1 + 2)\hat{i} + (1 + 1 - 2)\hat{j} + (3 + 4 - 8)\hat{k} = 2\hat{i} + 0\hat{j} - \hat{k} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{k}$$

Now compute $\vec{Q} = \vec{A} \times \vec{B}$:
$$\vec{A} \times \vec{B} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 1 & 1 & 3 \\ -1 & 1 & 4 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(4 - 3) - \hat{j}(4 + 3) + \hat{k}(1 + 1) = \hat{i} - 7\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}$$

Dot product:
$$\vec{P} \cdot \vec{Q} = (2\hat{i} - \hat{k}) \cdot (\hat{i} - 7\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}) = 2 \times 1 + 0 \times (-7) + (-1) \times 2 = 2 - 2 = 0$$

Since dot product is zero, $\vec{P}$ and $\vec{Q}$ are perpendicular. Hence the angle between them is $90^\circ$, which corresponds to option C.
